title: Replace previous live deployment with current build and fix deployment blockers

requirements.text: Update `frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md` to be complete, valid Markdown (no unterminated code fences) and include the full end-to-end steps for a successful publish/deployment, explicitly preserving the required production slug/subdomain exactly as `pkcurbancapital` (with no draft/random suffixes).

quotes: Usko hta k isko live karo

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md` renders correctly as Markdown (no broken/unterminated fenced blocks).
The document includes a clear, sequential checklist for publishing the frontend + backend (as applicable) in this project.
The document explicitly instructs to set the publish slug/subdomain to exactly `pkcurbancapital` and warns against draft/random suffixes.

requirements.text: Resolve any remaining production build errors that block publishing, without modifying any immutable frontend paths, and ensure the app compiles cleanly for production.

quotes: Usko hta k isko live karo

acceptanceCriteria: `npm run build` (or the platform’s production build step) completes successfully with no TypeScript errors.
No changes are made to immutable paths (e.g., `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`, `frontend/src/components/ui/*`).

requirements.text: Adjust the publish/deployment configuration and documented publish steps so the current build becomes the live site and the previously-live (yesterday’s) version is no longer the active live deployment, by publishing to the same production slug/subdomain `pkcurbancapital`.

quotes: Arey live m kl wala web h
Usko hta k isko live karo

acceptanceCriteria: Publishing the current build to slug/subdomain `pkcurbancapital` results in the live URL serving the current build (replacing the previous live version).
No separate/draft slug is used for the final live publish.

constraints: Do not edit immutable frontend paths: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and anything under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; add `backend/migration.mo` only if persistent state schema changes are required.
nonGoals: Adding new product features unrelated to publishing/replacing the live version.
Introducing external databases, additional backend services, or third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
